notablePrerequisites: Nightscape Master does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Nightscape Master by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
